Senses.Explanation: The line completes a spring scene in which a graceful figure entering the flower garden draws an oriole from the willow. AlternateTargets: be afraid at the sight of a broken well-rope
SearchAliases: be afraid at the sight of a broken well-rope
Senses.Explanation: “Fear even a broken well-rope” is the second half of Wuzu Fayan’s full analogy: “Once bitten by a snake, one fears even a broken well-rope.” The injury supplies the stated cause for later overcaution toward a harmless look-alike. Fayan speaks it after raising earlier treatments of Manjushri and Samantabhadra for producing “buddha-view” and “dharma-view.” A parallel Fayan record preserves the same turn. Tian’an Sheng quotes it and directly criticizes Fayan’s handling before stating his own response; Yulin Tongxiu raises the same full analogy and caps it with “one household has an affair, a hundred households are busy.” The phrase is an analogy spoken in that case, not a literal report about wells and not a universal rule about every later fear.
Senses.Note: Read the headword with its attested causal first half, “once bitten by a snake”; it is an injury-and-overcaution analogy inside one inherited case family.

Occurrences.Kwic: 晚參。舉：「世尊因文殊、普賢起佛見法見，被世尊威神攝向二鐵圍山。白雲端和尚道：『世尊無大人相。』五祖演和尚道：『白雲則具大慈悲。』遂拍手，云：『曼殊室利、普賢大士，不審不審，今後更敢也無？』自云：『一度被蛇傷，怕見斷井索。』」師云：「世尊無大人相，白雲不敢動著；演祖隨情摟搜，猶欠末後一著。」

Occurrences.Kwic: 南泉云：文殊、普賢昨夜三更起，佛見、法見各與二十棒，貶向二鐵圍山。白雲則具大慈悲，遂拍手云：曼殊室利、普賢大士，不審！不審！今後更敢也無？自云：一度被蛇傷，怕見斷井索。難難義何般，易易沒巴鼻，好好催人老默默。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Source record (X/X68/X68n1318.xml). Continued Essentials from the Sayings of Ancient Worthies. The occurrence stands inside the Wuzu Fayan section; 自云 assigns the analogy to Fayan. It is a parallel witness to the same original turn, not a new deployment family.

Occurrences.Kwic: 有偈呈方丈：『曠劫無明當下歇，甕裏何曾走卻鱉。若更問我意如何，大冶紅爐飛片雪。』
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Shanxi Baishan Kai (山西柏山楷禪師語錄): Baishan Kai uses the rhetorical line in his own presented awakening verse.

Occurrences.Kwic: 悟曰：『甕裏何曾走卻鱉？』公曰：『且喜老漢腳跟點地。』悟曰：『莫謗他好。』公休去。拈曰：果然超邁，不然圓悟腳跟未易許他摸著。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Recorded Sayings of Chan Master Xueguan (雪關禪師語錄): Xueguan quotes Yuanwu using the line as an immediate reply and then comments on the exchange.

Senses.Explanation: This rhetorical line says that what is enclosed in the jar has never escaped. Baishan Dekai uses 甕裏何曾走卻鱉 in a verse presented after his breakthrough. Yuanwu Keqin uses the same line as an immediate reply; Yingshan Zhiyin later quotes and comments on that exchange.
